rationale: C12 provides a concrete, nearly verbatim drafting template: it uses the same comprehensive list of tax returns, the same cutoff through 1950, inspection by a Senate committee or duly authorized subcommittee, a purpose-specific clause, incorporation of conditions in a contemporaneously approved Treasury decision, and the same Federal Register effectiveness provision. The child chiefly substitutes the Senate committee and investigative purpose and adds a congressional-duration limitation. C25 is essentially identical to C12 and also strongly qualifies, while C01 uses the same machinery with somewhat different period and session limitations.
